user.title: mKraków login
user.description: Same credentials as in the mKraków app. The password is only used to send the SMS and is not stored. The last three fields are app constants – copy them from a Proxyman capture (see README).

sms.title: SMS code
sms.description: Enter the code from the SMS you just received.

reauth_confirm.title: mKraków session expired
reauth_confirm.description: Enter your password – a new SMS code will be sent.

error.invalid_auth: Wrong PESEL, password or app headers.
